title: TikTok videos from the week's data
items: The weekly graphics job now also renders vertical 1080x1920 videos: a Top 25 countdown for football and basketball, the Top 5 games, Upset Watch, Game of the Week, and a receipts video with the record, the expected rate and the market comparison, plus last week's upset calls once they are settled.
Every number comes from the same sourced, expiring post items as the X drafts. Each video ends on a plain-language note, such as 'Forecasting, not betting advice'.
Videos have no audio, so a TikTok sound can be added in the app. Nothing is posted automatically.
